name: HDFC Bank Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest private-sector bank (market cap ~Rs11.6 lakh cr), merged with HDFC Ltd in July 2023. Retail, wholesale and mortgage lending, deposits, cards and payments; subsidiaries include HDFC Life (about half owned), HDFC AMC (about half owned), HDB Financial (model knowledge). Q2 FY27 standalone PAT Rs19,510cr (+4.7% y/y), NII +10%, deposits +19%. Stock is down ~23.5% over 12 months (52w low late Oct 2026) amid leadership transition: Anup Bagchi named MD & CEO on 2026-10-01 after RBI sign-off, and further senior executives have left.

exposures.mechanism: Post-merger HDFC Bank has the largest floating, repo/EBLR-linked book (~55-60% of loans, model estimate) so loans reprice at once; deposits (CASA trails time deposits, Q2) reprice with a lag => transient NIM gain (+5-10bp per sell-side), worth +0.5-1% of PAT at persistence 0.25; but P/E de-rating from tighter policy (-1.5). Net -0.5 with a wide band.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo to 5.50%, stance calibrated tightening (The Hindu / SCC Online)

exposures.mechanism: Q2 PAT growth was held to 4.7% by a Rs1,610cr treasury drop (NiftyTrader 2026-10-17): treasury MTM is live. 10y +25bp on ~Rs1.2 lakh cr AFS/HFT x duration 2.5 = ~Rs750cr = ~1% of PAT, persistence 0.25; cost-of-equity effect ~-1.5.

evidence.note: Q2 standalone PAT Rs19,510cr (+4.7%), NII +10%, deposits +19%, treasury drop Rs1,610cr (Moneycontrol/NiftyTrader)

exposures.mechanism: Core constraint is credit-deposit ratio normalisation after the HDFC Ltd merger: deposits +18.8% in Q2 but CASA share falling. +3pp deposit growth lowers marginal funding cost and lets loan growth outpace deposits; ~Rs27 lakh cr loans, NII +3%, PAT +4.5%, persistence 0.75 => +3.5.
+3pp system credit growth => HDFC Bank loan growth capped by deposits; incremental effect on PAT ~+3.5% at 0.75 persistence = ~+2.5.
+50bp credit cost on ~Rs27 lakh cr loans = Rs13,500cr pre-tax = Rs10,100cr post-tax vs TTM PAT Rs83,685cr = -12%; persistence 0.5 => -6. Current credit cost is among the lowest in the sector.

evidence.note: Q2 standalone PAT Rs19,510cr (+4.7%), NII +10%, deposits +19%, treasury drop Rs1,610cr (Moneycontrol/NiftyTrader)

exposures.mechanism: Unsecured (cards, PL) ~Rs2.4 lakh cr (~9%): +1pp delinquency x LGD 80% = Rs1,900cr pre-tax = 1.7% of PAT x 0.5 => -0.9; sector sentiment adds -0.6.

Largest FPI holding in the index: FIIs fell from 44.05% (Mar) to 39.39% (Sep) while stock -23.5% over 12 months. A US$5bn/qtr swing is ~0.4% of mcap Rs11.6 lakh cr; flow-beta approach => +3.5. Reversal is the main re-rating lever.
As India's largest bank (D-SIB) it carries the highest capital buffer; a tightening step (CRR/SLR/LCR, ECL) costs ~-2. RBI approval was also needed for the new CEO.

evidence.note: HDFC Bank names Anup Bagchi MD & CEO; shares -2.3% on 2026-10-05

exposures.mechanism: +1pp GDP => loans +1.5pp, credit cost down; PAT +3-4%, persistence 0.75 => +2.5.
Empirical -0.91/SSU (t=-2.0) is a rotation pattern (money leaving US to India? or the reverse) not a causal link; shrunk almost to zero.
Brent -> CPI/INR -> RBI path and FPI risk appetite. Pack empirical Brent -0.56/SSU (t=-1.7) is consistent in sign: Brent +10% -> -0.6%; scenario escalation = +20-30% Brent => -2.5 incl. risk-off.
Matches empirical -0.56 (t=-1.7): higher oil raises India's CAD/INR pressure and rate expectations.
Empirical +2.09 (t=2.3) and cotton -1.29 (t=-2.4) are statistically significant but have no fundamental path to a bank (likely a spurious period effect); set to ~0 and ignored.

company_links.mechanism: w = % change in HDFCBANK equity value per +1% in HDFCLIFE equity (source-equity-move units). HDFC Bank holds ~50% of HDFC Life (model knowledge; Rs1.2-1.5 lakh cr mcap) => ~5-6% of its own mcap in look-through value, less holding discount.
w per +1% in HDFCAMC equity: ~52% stake in HDFC AMC, value ~4% of HDFC Bank mcap (model knowledge).
